cluster_summary: This cluster comprises vulnerabilities resulting from insecure defaults in XML processing. The majority involve XML parsers that do not disable DTD processing or external entity resolution, enabling XXE attacks. Other issues include insecure deserialization via XMLDecoder, XSLT extension function abuse, resource exhaustion from missing EOF checks, variable interpolation leaking system properties, and NTLM credential exposure through namespace URI resolution.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-controlled or externally supplied XML documents, SOAP messages, XML reports, configuration files, XPath inputs, or XSLT stylesheets into XML parser, XPath, transformer, schema, or SOAP/XML utility code that parses or transforms those documents. Report code paths where DTD declarations, external general entities, external parameter entities, external schema access, or external stylesheet access are not disabled or constrained on the exact parser/transformer instance. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 64 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should disable DOCTYPE and external entity processing, restrict external-access properties, and install a resolver or parser configuration that rejects external resource resolution before parsing.

mechanism.missing_guard: DTD declarations, external general entities, external parameter entities, external schema access, or external stylesheet access are not disabled or constrained on the exact parser/transformer instance
mechanism.name: unsafe XML parser external entity or DTD resolution
mechanism.sink_shape: XML parser, XPath, transformer, schema, or SOAP/XML utility code that parses or transforms those documents
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-controlled or externally supplied XML documents, SOAP messages, XML reports, configuration files, XPath inputs, or XSLT stylesheets
mechanism.typical_fix: disable DOCTYPE and external entity processing, restrict external-access properties, and install a resolver or parser configuration that rejects external resource resolution before parsing

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Explicitly disable DTD declarations and external entity resolution by setting appropriate features on the parser factory (e.g., disallow-doctype-decl, external-general-entities=false, external-parameter-entities=false, FEATURE_SECURE_PROCESSING, ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD empty) or by providing a restrictive EntityResolver that blocks external resources.
sub_patterns.name: Missing secure parser configuration against external entity resolution
sub_patterns.root_cause: XML parser factories (DocumentBuilderFactory, SAXParserFactory, XMLInputFactory, SAXBuilder, etc.) are instantiated with default settings that permit DTD processing and external entity resolution. The code fails to disable these unsafe features before parsing untrusted XML input.

sub_patterns.name: Missing secure XML parser configuration and unsafe deserialization
